proof_scope: Tau retained agentic-eval evidence index build and fail-closed verification

claims.proves: Tau builds a verifier-owned evidence index over retained agentic-eval reports and referenced artifacts, re-reads that index without regenerating reports, and fails closed on mutation, substitution, deletion, and dirty-tree controls.
claims.does_not_prove: Provider semantic quality, human acceptance of the full five-DAG product outcome, or that the verifier's self-referential agentic-evals report is itself a milestone input.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Tau content-addresses retained agentic-eval reports and report-referenced artifacts, records report commands and runner schema version, binds report source SHA/ref and checkout dirty-tree declarations, and verifies the retained evidence fail-closed.
